purpose: AMD Thread Trace instruction-level pipeline evidence
preconditions: warm JIT and tuned-config caches outside the trace
run exactly one steady-state target dispatch
use a kernel include regex to avoid tracing unrelated kernels
record GPU/CU/SIMD selection and rocprofv3 version
repeat representative CTA/wave roles when the kernel is persistent or specialized

outputs.information: per-instruction Hitcount, Latency, Stall, Idle and Source
occupancy context for the traced dispatch

helps_diagnose: MFMA starvation or low issue density
wave-role imbalance and long dependency chains
not_measured: all ranks or all CUs unless explicitly repeated
causal speedup without a controlled candidate

metric_semantics.Latency: Stall + Issue on gfx9, or Stall + Execute on gfx10+
metric_semantics.Stall: hardware-pipe backpressure cycles already included in Latency
metric_semantics.Idle: gap caused by arbitration, register dependency, or instruction-cache miss
metric_semantics.accounted_cycles: Latency + Idle; never add Stall twice

provenance.notes: Flags and output names came from a working gfx950 GEMM ATT collection; probe current rocprofv3 because CLI options are version-dependent.
